office: the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship
note: WikiProcedure's guide (a procedures wiki): any Zambian without an NRC, from 16, may apply; no fees are required; the card is valid forever. The Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security's pages weren't reached and the Zambian Observer's report refused this session; the time isn't stated.

sources.said: Any Zambian citizen who doesn't have an NRC. Any child who's going to be 16 years of age. Fees Edit Application Fee : No fees are required for NRC. Validity Edit This document is valid forever.
